# Starpass Stone

> Starpass Stone (Starpass Limited) — natural stone works since 1998. Any work
> with natural stone: supply and selection of marble, granite, onyx, travertine
> and quartzite; design, fabrication, installation and maintenance. Serving the
> Côte d'Azur (Nice, Cannes, Monaco, Saint-Tropez, Antibes, Menton), Dublin and
> all of Ireland. Languages: English, French, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian.

## Services

- Stone fireplaces: classic, electric and bio-ethanol
- Hammam (Turkish bath) construction — private and commercial, mosaic and marble
- Sauna construction — equipment (EOS, Sawo), production, engineering
- Stone staircases (solid and cladded)
- Marble columns and architectural elements
- Kitchen worktops and table tops from book-matched slabs
- Stone bathrooms (vanities, basins, walls, floors)
- Stone facades and floors
- Outdoor BBQ zones and summer kitchens
- Stone restoration and lifelong maintenance
- Interior design projects with author's supervision
- Transparent costing and guidance before any work begins

## Stones

Calacatta marble, Sadolit Blue quartzite, Ukrainian Labradorite granite,
Nero Marquina marble, translucent Onyx, travertine, and other stones selected
at quarries worldwide.

## Service area

Côte d'Azur / French Riviera: Nice, Cannes, Monaco, Saint-Tropez, Antibes,
Menton. Also Dublin and all of Ireland. The team travels to site for
measurement, installation and author's supervision.
